def: Groq's inference accelerator, which keeps model weights in fast on-chip SRAM instead of external high-bandwidth memory to reach high per-user token speeds.
practice: Offered through GroqCloud; little memory per chip means one large model spans many chips, and NVIDIA licensed Groq's technology in December 2025 for its announced Groq 3 LPX racks (as of November 2026).
